verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app builder like Bolt.new, so the axis applies. No evidence item mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or tracking controls. Project and site visibility settings (public/private) and the Supabase data-control option are adjacent features and do not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
